tests.scope: existing retry, timeout, cache and facade contracts
seven new native atomic/preservation contracts and existing dataset single-download proof

behavior: Whole pack staged on destination filesystem before final atomic directory publication.
Stream or publication failure leaves final empty cache reusable and cleans temporary staging.
Duplicate flattened basenames refused before fetching.
Existing private cache and files arriving during download preserved.
Streaming responses closed and successful file bytes flushed before directory publication.
limitations: Existing nonempty legacy cache is preserved and trusted as before; old corruption cannot be identified without a manifest.
No live network, model, GPU, full CI or native Windows/macOS run.
Abrupt OS process termination may leave a hidden sibling staging folder, never a published partial pack.
